entries.wording: Arrived at the first mile sorting center
entries.note: The first scan in TopYou's hands, at its warehouse in China.

entries.wording: Departed from the first mile sorting center
Arrived at airport of the original country
Departed from Airport to destination country
Arrived at destination airport
Departed from customs
entries.note: Released by the destination country's customs. The tracker leaves the country after "of" empty, which the adapter drops.

entries.wording: At U.S. Postal Service facility, Accepted by U.S. Postal Service
entries.note: USPS takes the parcel over from TopYou's line in the United States, after the flight; it is no first acceptance.

entries.wording: Carrier received the shipment
entries.note: The first scan in TopYou's hands, worded for its newer waybills.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at a carrier facility
entries.note: Under the code for leaving the first-mile warehouse, after TopYou received the parcel: movement, not its acceptance.

entries.wording: Shipment started the customs clearance process at origin
Shipment arrived in the destination country
Shipment started the customs clearance process at destination
entries.note: Import clearance, under the code for arriving in the destination country.

entries.wording: Shipment completed the customs clearance process at destination
entries.note: Cleared and on its way to the delivery carrier, not held in customs.

entries.wording: Shipment is out for delivery
entries.note: The hand-over to GOFO in France and Italy: it comes at GOFO's first sorting-centre scan, days before GOFO's delivery round ("The driver is out for delivery").

entries.wording: Arrived at GOFO Regional Destination Facility
entries.note: GOFO's arrival at its regional depot, relayed at the second of GOFO's own scan.

entries.wording: The driver is out for delivery
entries.note: GOFO's delivery round, relayed at the second of GOFO's own scan.

entries.wording: In Transit, Your order has been shipped from 【iMile Köln DC Center】.
entries.note: iMile's scan in Germany, relayed after iMile's label for its step; iMile's map stages the sentence.

entries.wording: Delivery, Your order has arrived at 【Dortmund01】
entries.note: iMile's arrival at its delivery station.

entries.wording: Delivery, Your order has assigned delivery drvier.
entries.note: iMile names the driver before the parcel leaves the station; the misspelling is iMile's.

entries.wording: Delivery, Our delivery associate is out for delivery.
